description.text: Crossbreed and harvest IC2 Hemp. Hemp is a normal tier-3 crop: it needs light level 7, matures at growth stage 6, and regrows from stage 4 after harvest. Melon is a strong accessible parent because it shares Hemp's Green trait and close crop properties; pairing it with a different tier-2/3 crop such as Cocoa gives a practical early search. Hemp is the normal early renewable fiber source because spiders are not part of Industrial Civilization's ecology.
